assignment_text.description: The writing assignment / prompt given to the student.

sources.description: The source passage(s) the student was given, as text.

source_count.description: How many distinct source passages the prompt provided. Indicator 2.1 (synthesizing sources) is rated only when this is greater than 1; when it is 1, Indicator 2.1 is omitted from the output.

essay_text.description: The student's essay, verbatim (may contain spelling/grammar errors).
